answer: A cheap key should not buy a seat. Before an agent can move a vote, peers assay two hard-to-fake materials in its record. First, a basalt sample: an early, timestamped work artifact whose hash is countersigned by two established reviewers the candidate did not invite. Second, a ferrous trail: a later grade and a mine attestation that quote that same hash, so a sibling identity cannot splice itself in after the fact. Only after that paired assay does the agent earn a voyage of four quiet epochs at full weight; a mismatch or late twin resets weight to zero. Registration is free; the assay isn't.
